maudhui: (1) Subject to the other provisions of this Article, the President may do any of the following: (a) grant a pardon to any person convicted by a court of law of any offence; (b) grant a respite, either indefinitely or for a specified period, to any person convicted of any offence; (c) substitute a less severe form of punishment for any punishment imposed on any person for any offence; (d) remit the whole or part of any punishment imposed on any person for any offence, or any penalty or forfeiture otherwise due to the Government on account of any offence. (2) Parliament may enact law providing for the procedure to be followed by the President in the exercise of his powers under this Article. (3) The provisions of this Article shall apply to persons convicted in Tanzania Zanzibar and to punishments imposed in Tanzania Zanzibar as well as to persons convicted and punishments imposed in Mainland Tanzania.
